purpose: Composition law only. Does not inhabit any unsolved mathematical producer.

new_classes.SevenInhabitants: field-wise seven material cores; one proof per ProblemId
new_classes.UniversalKernel: Core + Endpoint + consume : forall p, Core p -> Endpoint p
new_classes.ExactUniversalKernel: UniversalKernel + reflect : forall p, Endpoint p -> Core p
new_classes.FinalRootInputs: seven material inhabitants + mechanical proof + release proof

new_operators.SevenEndpoints.ofForall: packs forall-lane endpoint proofs without loss

new_laws.sevenInhabitants_iff_forall: SevenInhabitants Core <-> forall p, Core p
new_laws.sevenEndpoints_iff_forall: SevenEndpoints Endpoint <-> forall p, Endpoint p
new_laws.exact_universal_closure_iff: with reflect, SevenEndpoints K.Endpoint <-> SevenInhabitants K.Core
new_laws.universal_final_root: seven material proofs + mechanical + release -> FinalRootResult

anti_noise_firewall: No count or Boolean can manufacture a material proof field.
No accepted hypothesis is embedded in UniversalKernel.
A claimed exact reduction must provide a reverse reflect map.
Mechanical and release gates are separate from mathematical inhabitants.
Universal closure provides composition only; it does not solve any open theorem.
